definitions.short: a cord (of a tent); or the string (of a bow)
definitions.full: H4340. methar [ מֵיתָר ] noun masculine cord, string (compare II. יֶתֶר ); of tent- cords מֵתָרַי Jer 10:20 ; מֵיתָרַיִךְ Isa 54:2 ; specifically of cords of tabernacle, מֵיתָרָיו Exod 39:40 ; Num 3:26 ; מֵיתְרֵיהֶם Exod 35:18 ; Num 3:37 ; 4:26 , 32 (all P); of bow- strings מֵיתָרֶיךָ Psa 21:13 .
